The '''Industrial Levels''',<ref name="Jewel" /> also known as the '''Factory Levels''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> were levels 221-280 of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and processing equipment, such as [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbonite freezing facilities]] composed those levels.<ref name="Jewel" />
